07 / B2B & SaaS

Suntech — A domestic logistics and content management platform

Every element of the site is managed without a developer.

2026
Scope
B2B & SaaS

01 / Overview

Suntech.az is a web platform presenting a company’s internal logistics services. Its core is a large admin panel that lets non-developers change the site’s structure, add or delete pages and manage all content.

02 / The problem

The logistics company’s service list and equipment fleet changed often, but every small text edit needed a developer, so the site lagged behind reality.

03 / Our approach

Frontend and backend are fully separated: Next.js SSR renders the showcase site and a .NET Core API serves the content. Each page created in the admin panel gets an automatic URL and is added to the navigation structure.

04 / The result

The content team manages the site on its own. Server-side rendering makes pages load quickly and index correctly in search engines.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Fully controlled admin panel

    Every text, image and structural element is editable.

  • 02

    Dynamic page management

    Create, edit, hide or delete unlimited pages.

  • 03

    Logistics-focused content

    Shipping rules, the equipment fleet and corporate information in one platform.

  • 04

    Performance and SEO

    Next.js SSR keeps pages fast and indexable.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Headless approach

    A future mobile app could connect to the same API.

  2. Dynamic routing

    Each page created in the admin panel gets an automatic URL integrated into the structure.
